items.title: Wells Fargo Analyst: SpaceX Wireless Will Crush Carriers While Tower REITs “Quietly” Profit
items.summary: A Wells Fargo analyst says SpaceX's wireless push will hurt carriers far less than investors fear, and the real beneficiaries may surprise anyone who assumed satellite and towers compete rather than cooperate.

items.title: Is Charter Communications Stock Underperforming the Nasdaq?
items.summary: Charter Communications is lagging the broader market, with analysts cautious amid persistent business pressures.

items.title: Why Comcast Stock Is One of the Worst Performers in the S&P 500 Today

items.title: Comcast drops 7% on persistent broadband losses and ’irrational’ fiber pricing
items.summary: Investing.com -- Comcast Corporation (NASDAQ: CMCSA) shares dropped 7% on Wednesday following cautionary remarks at the Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference regarding persistent challenges in its broadband division. Charter Communications shares also fell 5% amid the broader sector sell-off. items.title: Comcast Sinks 8%, Charter Drops 6%, T-Mobile Slips 3%: Is a Broadband Repricing Underway?
items.summary: Comcast and Charter are tanking in unison today with no fresh filings or analyst actions to explain the size of the moves, and the usual culprit of wireless competition does not quite fit either.

items.title: Why Does AT&T Stock Still Trade Like It Is Shrinking?
items.summary: AT&T (T) trades at 8.2 times earnings against an S&P 500 median of 23.0, and it got there the hard way: the stock returned -9.4% over the past year while the index returned +19.3%. A profitable telecom throwing off cash at that discount is what value buyers hunt for.

items.summary: Pinterest’s CFO exits to join OpenAI chairman’s startup Sierra, Charter’s CFO heads to Blackstone-Google AI infrastructure venture and Deutsche Telekom and T‑Mobile name new CFOs.

items.title: VZ Keeps Climbing. Should You Climb On?
items.summary: This telecom giant is on a tear, but for investors arriving at the high, the real question is whether the engine has enough fuel left for another lap.
